test_cases.path_step: A Teacher uploads necessary materials by accessing the 'Files' tab and using the appropriate buttons to add new files or file groups.
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 1: Teacher Initializes and Sets Up the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Uploads Course Materials - No File Selected
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'ValidPassword123!Giangteacher' is logged into the system. The course 'Introduction to Software Engineering' with an image 'software_eng_image.jpg' exists and its information has been updated. A session 'Introduction to Software Testing' scheduled for '2024-06-15' at '10:00 AM' has been created for this course. The user is currently on the 'Course Details Page' for 'Introduction to Software Engineering'.
test_cases.expected_result: The system should display an error message indicating that a file must be selected for upload, and the user should remain on the 'Add files' modal. The file structure should remain unchanged.
test_cases.post_condition: The user is still on the 'Add files' modal on the 'Course Details Page' for 'Introduction to Software Engineering', with an error message displayed. No new file or file group is added to the course.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Files' tab on the Course Details Page.
Click the 'Add File Button' to open the 'Add files' modal.
Click the 'Upload Button' without selecting a file.

test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 1: Teacher Initializes and Sets Up the Course
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher is logged into the system and is on the Course Details Page for an existing course, with the 'Files' tab active.
test_cases.expected_result: The specified file is successfully uploaded and added to the course, and the updated file structure is displayed. The system reports a successful upload.
test_cases.post_condition: The course's file structure is updated with the new material. The Teacher remains on the Course Details Page, 'Files' tab.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Files' tab to navigate to the file management section.
Click the 'Add File' button to open the file upload modal.
Select a valid file named 'syllabus.pdf' for upload in the 'File Uploader' field.
Click the 'Upload Button' to submit the file.
